description: This file defines Hebrew localization (language strings) for the 'placeholder' plugin in CKEditor. It sets translated labels for various UI elements like 'title', 'toolbar', 'text', 'edit', and 'textMissing'.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: A method of CKEDITOR.plugins that assigns language strings to a plugin, in this case 'placeholder', for the Hebrew language ('he').
